gbm_population_evidence.quote: Cohort Phase IID: Any recurrent glioblastoma without MYC or MYCN amplifications.

candidate_evidence.quote: PLX038 is a PEGylated macromolecule that contains 4 molecules of SN-38, the active metabolite of irinotecan, that is currently being investigated in non-CNS solid tumor trials.
[EXPERIMENTAL] Phase II: RP2D of PLX038 (interventions: Drug: PLX038)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Cohort Phase IIA: Newly diagnosed MYCN amplified ependymoma after surgery and radiation.
Cohort Phase I: Any recurrent or progressive primary CNS tumor, regardless of molecular features.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: PLX038 drug distribution will be investigated in peripheral blood and tumor tissue post-treatment administration.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Molecular biomarkers of treatment response or resistance will be investigated in an exploratory manner pre and post-treatment (after cycle 2 and after tumor progression) in tumor tissue, hair follicles, and peripheral blood.

role_evidence.quote: In the Phase II component, participants will be treated with the TOP1 inhibitor PLX038 at the RP2D intravenously every 3 weeks

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational PEGylated SN-38 conjugate (long-acting topoisomerase 1 inhibitor; SN-38 is the active metabolite of irinotecan)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: SN-38 inhibits topoisomerase 1; MYC-driven transcription forms topoisome complexes requiring TOP1
arms: Phase I: Escalating and de-escalating doses of PLX038

source_quote.quote: Cohort Phase IIC: Any other recurrent or progressive primary CNS tumor with MYC or MYCN amplifications.

flag.reason: Record links MYC-driven topoisome complexes to TOP1 dependence, but MYC/MYCN is not the direct target of PLX038; and the GBM cohort (IID) requires absence of the amplification.

coder_notes: Primary CNS tumour trial (medulloblastoma, ependymoma, gliomas); glioblastoma named in conditions and as Phase IID cohort (MYC/MYCN non-amplified recurrent GBM), so mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Arm labels used in full as registered ('Phase I: ...' and 'Phase II: ...' with their descriptions as written after the colon may be how labels are parsed; labels here taken as the text before the colon would be 'Phase I'/'Phase II'). A second unnamed drug given 3 days after PLX038 to reduce infection risk (self-injected subcutaneously, likely a G-CSF) is given to all participants but not named, so not listed as an agent; it would be supportive. PLX038 is a PEGylated SN-38 conjugate, coded formulation_flag prodrug. GBM patients are recurrent; trial overall includes a newly diagnosed ependymoma cohort -> both. Target engagement unclear: exploratory pre/post tumour biomarkers not explicitly linked to TOP1.
